Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. About the Role
Owns the employee lifecycle - onboarding, transitions and offboarding - blending empathy with execution so every touchpoint reflects our culture, efficiency and care. You will partner with HR Business Partners, IT, Workplace and Finance to deliver accurate processes and experiences that keep employees confident, connected and supported from Day 1.

lists.content:
1. Onboarding & Assimilation 

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding lifecycle, from pre-boarding to post-joining assimilation, with accuracy, compliance and a strong Day 1 experience. 

  • Run orientation sessions on mission, culture and structure, and coordinate with IT, Workplace and HR on Day 1 readiness. 

  • Facilitate assimilation programmes - new-joiner connects, check-ins, buddy programmes and milestone feedback. 

  • Maintain a feedback-driven onboarding framework, using HR automation, AI-assisted drafting and self-service chatbots to cut manual effort and turnaround. 

2. Offboarding & Exit Management 

  • Manage offboarding end-to-end, from resignation to last working day, tracking timelines and process steps. 

  • Coordinate clearance across IT, Finance, Workplace, HR Shared Services and reporting managers through to completion. 

  • Issue exit documentation (resignation acceptance, relieving and experience letters) accurately and on time, and prepare and validate final settlement inputs for payroll within cut-offs. 

  • Conduct exit interviews where applicable, capturing feedback and attrition trends to inform retention. 

3. HR Operations & Data Governance 

  • Maintain accuracy and integrity of employee data across HRIS and onboarding platforms. 

  • Support lifecycle transactions - confirmations, internal transfers and related documentation. 

  • Ensure compliance and audit readiness through timely updates and report validation. 

  • Generate MIS and dashboard reports for reviews, using automation to streamline recurring outputs. 

4. Engagement & Partnering 

  • Drive site-level engagement, culture-building, celebrations and recognition that reinforce belonging.

  • Track engagement metrics and feedback to spot trends, using analytics tools to speed up sentiment analysis. 

  • Partner with the HR Business Partner on lifecycle initiatives, pulse surveys and location-level interventions, providing on-ground operational support to employees and managers. 

  • Work with Talent Acquisition, Finance, IT and Workplace to ensure smooth, accountable process delivery.

• HR Tools proficiency: Hands-on experience with Darwinbox, Fresh Services and MS Suite.
  • Operational excellence: Strong coordination, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities to deadline.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills across diverse audiences.
  • Data & AI judgement: Comfortable using HRIS, Excel and generative AI tools efficiently, with sound judgement on accuracy, data privacy and manual review.
  • Culture champion: Empathy and energy to deliver people-first experiences in a fast-moving environment.

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Industrial Psychology, or a related field. A Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 2–3 years of experience for Associate and 3–5 years of experience for Senior Associate in HR Operations, Onboarding, or Generalist roles, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.

About the Role

Zeta is seeking an Associate Director – Legal to serve as a strategic advisor within its legal team. The role supports the company's technology business, including its SaaS platforms for banks and financial institutions, as it scales across India, the US, the UK, and other global markets.This is a high-impact, product-facing role for a seasoned lawyer with deep expertise in technology contracts and a strong understanding of the banking and financial services sector that Zeta's platforms serve.
 
The role involves making sure Zeta's products, partnerships, and client engagements are structured and delivered in a legally sound way. Reporting to Zeta's India legal leadership, the Associate Director will work closely with the Product, Sales, Engineering, Compliance, and Information Security teams, with significant autonomy and visibility. The ideal candidate will own matters end to end, negotiate directly with clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, and lead a team of capable lawyers. They will also help shape the legal function of a fast-growing global technology company.

lists.content:
• Draft, review, and negotiate B2B SaaS contracts, outsourcing contracts, software development agreements, license agreements, and managed-services, partnership, and third-party vendor agreements with clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, making sure they align with legal and business requirements.

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on all aspects of technology contracts.

  • While anchored in technology law, provide practical legal advice across all matters that affect the business, including corporate, commercial, employment, and intellectual property issues, and offer innovative solutions to minimize and manage legal risks across jurisdictions.

  • Manage the input from internal stakeholders that is needed to draft and review critical agreements.

  • Lead and mentor a team of lawyers, overseeing the quality and turnaround of contract reviews and negotiations.

  • Constantly improve the legal team's templates and playbooks, drawing on learnings from each client engagement.

  • Act as a business enabler, keeping the legal team aligned with Zeta's speed of delivery and culture of teamwork.

• Regulatory and commercial acumen: Commercially minded, pragmatic; translates complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal stakeholders.

  • Stakeholder management and communication: Strong communication and negotiation skills, sound and independent judgment, ability to counsel senior management strategically.

  • Execution and prioritization: Highly organized and detail-oriented; manages multiple matters simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth setting; ability to leverage AI for legal work highly preferred.

  • Team leadership and people management: Ability to lead and manage a team effectively.

  • Ownership and adaptability: Proactive self-starter, energized by ambiguity, comfortable in unfamiliar areas of law, takes ownership of outcomes, thrives in a collaborative, product-driven culture.

• 5-year BA LLB, BBA LLB or equivalent law degree from a recognized institution; qualified to practice law in India. An LLM is a plus but not mandatory

  • 9-12 years of post-qualification experience in the technology law practice of a top-tier law firm and/or as in-house counsel at a B2B SaaS technology company. Law firm experience mandatory.

  • Excellent grasp of the laws and market practices that apply to technology agreements, intellectual property, and data protection.

  • Strong contract drafting, review, and negotiation skills across B2B SaaS, outsourcing contracts, software licensing, software development, IT services, and IP licensing agreements.

  • Understanding of the nuances of technology agreements in the banking and financial services sector, with exposure to cross-border matters.

  • Proven experience leading and managing a team, including handling administrative responsibilities alongside substantive legal work.

With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. 
 
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
 
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
 
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
 
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.


About the Role: 
We are looking for an Associate level legal professional who can act as a trusted business advisor who works collaboratively across business, sales, and other functions and has the knowledge and experience required to take on a variety of legal assignments, such as  employment law advisory, intellectual property advisory and portfolio management, transactional support and assistance, SaaS Agreements with potential customers of Zeta, and agreements with SaaS Vendors who provide SaaS to Zeta for internal consumption or integration within Zeta’s SaaS Offerings.

lists.content:
• Drafting, negotiating, managing internal and external stakeholders, as well as managing external legal advisors assisting the company on such assignments.

  • Provide legal advice and opinions on all legal matters that impact the business and provide innovative solutions to minimize/manage the legal risks involved with the company’s business operations in various jurisdictions around the world

  • To communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (such as management, leadership teams, Finance, HR, Information Security etc) and external stakeholders (customers/clients, vendors, investor representatives, industry association representatives).

  • To constantly improve and evolve the drafts and templates created by the legal team, from learnings from each customer. Strive to simplify drafting in order to achieve quicker turn-around-times and to make legal agreements easier for non-legal stakeholders to understand.

• The candidate must have an excellent grasp of laws and market practices pertaining to a variety of technology agreements such as SaaS Master Service Agreements, Professional Services Agreements, Software Development Agreements; data protection laws and issues under a contract, intellectual property and other affiliated areas. 

  • The candidate should have the ability to work independently and within a team as and when required and must have unimpeachable integrity, honesty and the ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

  • The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills in order to communicate with persons across different walks of life and cultures and in order to understand business requirements and communicate the required solutions. 

  • Ability to explain contract risks and obligations to non-lawyers.

  • Attention to detail, speed, and efficiency in reviewing and drafting documents.

• 5 year BA.LLB (Hons) degree from a reputed national law university/college. (Mandatory Requirement) LLM or postgraduate degree in law from a reputed international law university specifically in the field of technology law. (Optional Requirement). 

  •  Post Qualification Experience: 4 years In a top tier law firm, preferably within the technology law practice of the firm or at the least some level of experience in technology contracts; and/or As an in-house counsel in a Technology Company (preferably, SaaS however Non-SaaS technology company experience will also be accepted) People with prior experience in law firms, but currently working as in-house counsel will be preferred over people with no prior law firm experience.

• Build and maintain cloud infrastructure and network automation across AWS, and Cloudflare environments. 
  • Troubleshoot production cloud, network, and CDN issues while improving operational efficiency through automation. 
  • Create technical documentation, automation runbooks, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams.  
  • Assist with day-to-day operational activities, change management, documentation, audit, compliance, and security best practices. 
  • Willingness to learn and support Data Center networking, Firewalls, WAF, DNS, SSL/TLS, and enterprise network security technologies.   
  • Interest in leveraging AI/LLMs to automate infrastructure operations, incident analysis, documentation, and network engineering workflows.

• Hands-on experience with AWS (mandatory), Linux, Kubernetes (EKS preferred), and Terraform or Cross plane. 
  • Strong scripting skills in Python or Bash for infrastructure and network automation. 
  • Good understanding of cloud networking, DNS, Load Balancers, VPC, Security Groups, TGW, Direct Connect, VPC Endpoint and REST APIs.  
  • Experience with CI/CD tools, Git, Helm, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).  
  • Knowledge of observability tools (Monitoring, Logging, Metrics, and Alerting) and DevSecOps best practices.  
  • Familiarity with AI-powered developer tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to improve coding, automation, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.   
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills with a passion for learning new technologies and automation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Information Technology, etc.).
  • 2–3 years of experience in Cloud Networking, Infrastructure Automation, or DevOps.
